name: Spectral CT Simulation
definition: Simulates polychromatic CT projections by integrating monochromatic components weighted by an effective X-ray spectrum, applying material attenuation via the Beer-Lambert law, and adding Poisson noise.
summary: Spectral CT Simulation generates polychromatic X-ray projections by integrating monochromatic attenuation components weighted by an effective X-ray spectrum, explicitly modeling energy dependence to accurately simulate beam-hardening artifacts.
